body: Dear Ms. Clarke,

emails.subject: Handover while I'm in Abu Dhabi
body: Hi Nadia,
I'm in Abu Dhabi Tuesday and Wednesday with the board pack, back Thursday morning. A few things so you don't get caught out in your first week:
1. Mr. Sokolov only ever calls me "Em", never Emma. He rings from his mobile, never the desk line. If anyone asks for "Emma Clarke" claiming to be him, it isn't him.
2. Thursday: Falcon Line picks him up at 7:15 for the board meeting. The confirmation should land in your inbox. Please check it's right.
3. Urgent supplier payments go through me, never through Finance directly. He confirms each one with this week's approval word. This week it's "saffron". Don't share it with anyone.
4. The Sandgrouse folder is off limits. Don't ask, I'll explain one day.
You're doing great. Shout if you need anything.
Em

emails.subject: Malware on 12th floor laptops: do not plug in USB sticks
body: All,

This morning a "visitor" checked in at the lobby kiosk with a valid visitor pass, walked onto the 12th floor and plugged USB sticks into three unattended laptops. All three are infected. We've pulled them off the network.
Until further notice: lock your screen when you leave your desk, never plug in a USB stick you didn't buy yourself, and report anything odd.
And if anyone calls asking for codes or passwords, hang up and call me.
Erik, IT help desk, ext. 214

emails.subject: Internship programme: update (confidential)
body: Hi all,
Following the gate code incident, Timur Bekov's internship in Operations is paused pending review. He hasn't been accused of anything, but he gave the code to a caller he believed was Mark.
Please be kind if you see him. He's taking it very hard.
Sara

emails.subject: Somebody gave out our gate code
body: Everyone,
On Sunday night someone drove through our Jebel Ali gate with a valid code and left with two containers of electronics. The code was given out over the phone.
I want to know how this happened, and I want it this week.
From today gate codes change every day and are never, ever read out over the phone. To anyone.
V. Sokolov

emails.subject: Jebel Ali break-in: what we know
body: Morning all,
Last night at 02:40 a truck opened the main gate with this week's code. The cameras show two people. They loaded two containers of electronics (the Al Noor order) and were gone by 03:25.
No alarm, because the code was valid. Police have the footage.
Mark is flying back from Riyadh today. Please don't talk to anyone outside the company about this.
Ruslan
